title: Grid DP
intuition: DP transitions performed over two-dimensional grid layouts, looking at top and left neighbors.
step_by_step_strategy: State: dp[i][j] is min/max value reaching coordinate (i, j).
common_mistakes: Index error on first row/column boundaries
Failing to initialize starting cell properly
complexity: Time: O(m * n), Space: O(m * n) or O(n)
content: DP transitions performed over two-dimensional grid layouts, looking at top and left neighbors.
